run_policy.protocol: Present each prompt and any supplied conversation context as a Skill-selection task using only installed Skill names and descriptions. Open every selected SKILL.md so loading is observable, report selected names, and do not solve the underlying task.
run_policy.repetition_rule: Run each affected case once per condition, then repeat only when variation, an unexpected result, model differences, or failure impact makes another observation decision-relevant.
run_policy.verdict_rule: Record pass, fail, unstable, not exposed, or not executed for every case. Mixed observed results are unstable, not a pass.

cases.prompt: Improve the production onboarding flow. I have not specified the users, current problem, success criteria, target environment, or acceptable risk. Help me determine what must be clarified before work starts.
Organize this feature idea into a decision-ready request with its intended outcome, completion criteria, constraints, assumptions, non-goals, unresolved items, and next action.

conversation.content: Help me clarify which customer group should receive the migration.
Which customer group is in scope, and is this a design request or an authorized migration?

cases.prompt: Enterprise customers are in scope. This is design only, but I have not decided whether existing sessions must remain valid.
The objective, success criteria, constraints, and non-goals are approved. Design the implementation approach, affected boundaries, risks, verification coverage, and stop conditions before editing.
The change approach, scope, authorization, and verification method are approved. Implement the code and documentation changes, run the checks, and report the result.
The bug report is decision-ready with reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior, environment, and acceptance criteria. Draft an unposted GitHub Issue that follows the repository template.
Review the effective pull request diff for actionable correctness, safety, compatibility, verification, maintainability, and performance problems.
